digest.component_or_area: LLM runner structured output & retry logic
propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured with single bounded Agent operation preserving full history and shared budget via HistoryProcessor wire projection
Wire projection must include ModelResponse on retry wire only when full request plus output reserve fits context window; omit entire response (never partial) when it does not fit or usage is unknown
Authoritative-input overflow must raise ContextWindowExceededError without content shortening; omit only prior ModelResponses via wire projection
Truncation (length/max_tokens) detected via finish_reason or provider_details must trigger concision ModelRetry in prompted mode only, sharing one output-retry counter with validation errors
Combined request_limit must equal base (ceil(eff_max_iter/2)) plus output-retry allowance, computed once with no per-attempt reset; base returned separately for inverse consumers
NativeOutput branch preserves output_mode selection, bug-895c grammar fallback, shared bounded operation, and terminal truncation behavior; concision guard applies only to prompted mode
